verdict.rationale: Munito AI's docs list tool calls as a capability across its OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs for open models. They also say coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode can connect, which implies agent loops are intended. Nothing documents parallel tool calls, multi-step tool use, or how reliably calls are executed. missing for 10: documented parallel tool-call support, documented multi-step agent-loop behavior, per-model tool-calling fidelity details, independent or hands-on corroboration that agent loops run without breaking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on faithful function/tool calling — including parallel and multi-step tool use — so agent loops run on open models without breaking
